summary: Decent Holding Inc., a PRC-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting a registered direct offering plus concurrent private placement priced October 2, 2026. The company sold 177,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.50 per share and pre-funded warrants for 645,828 shares at $1.4999 each, alongside unregistered PIPE warrants for 822,828 shares struck at $1.50 with a 1.5-year term, all to a single purchaser. Gross proceeds totaled $1,234,242 for working capital, with closing expected October 5, 2026; Pre-Funded Warrants carry a $0.0025 remaining exercise price and 4.99%/9.99% ownership caps. This is an ordinary financing, not a special situation; watch dilution, resale registration timing, and the 45-day issuance standstill.
